Context: 5. Entitlement

## 5. Entitlement  
- (a) Journey by Air/ Rail / Steamer.Same as on Tour/ Transfer but the facility of Air Travel for LTC is admissible only from Level 9.
- (b) Travel by premium trains.From 1-7-2017, travel by premium trains / premium tatkal trains / suvidha trains is permissible and the tatkal or premium charges shall also be reimbursable.
